result:
I found no bugs in round 188, so STORE-1c passes. All 14 rows I own were run in a real Playwright Chromium browser at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 375×812, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true.

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Header nav | Desktop and mobile both show exactly Collections, Studio, Free Samples, About, in that order, each landing on its page. Gift Cards, Hire Us, "Demo" and "Studio Lab" are gone from the header. Collections is underlined on `/store`. Selecting a mobile link closes the menu. |
| One h1 per page | All 8 pages have exactly one h1, both with JavaScript off and after the page loads. The header has no headings. |
| Wordmark | Plain text in the foreground colour (`rgb(238,239,241)`, no gradient), contrast 17.31:1. Clicking it from `/store` goes to `/`. The header height is unchanged (80.97 px at 1440 and 1280, 81 px at 375). |
| Footer | Reads `© 2026 CZABA. All rights reserved.`, and "Czaba Music" appears nowhere. The footer's Gift Cards and Hire Us links open their pages. |
| Pixel diff vs round 187 | 0 changed pixels outside the header and the copyright line. Home LCP is about 0.5 s and CLS is at most 0.02. |
| Studio and premium access | `/studio-lab` is pixel-identical to round 187. In a fresh anonymous browser, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and plays no audio. The stem token request returns 401 with no credentials and 403 with a fake token, so premium auth is not bypassed. This is checked against the mock backend, not the real one. |
| Tests | A's new test passes 9/9. Run against the pre-change files it fails 6 and passes 3 (the three auth tests stay green); my three one-line mutants also fail it. The 3 navigation e2e tests pass, but they are weak evidence: they still skip links they can't see and don't check link text. |

I ran the red proof through a scratch alias, so no source file was touched. The tree hashes and `git status` were checked at start and end.

Six info items for B. None is a bug in this round:
- **Loader h1:** B's note was wrong. The entrance loader (`SpotlightLoader.tsx:191`) has an h1, so on a first visit `/` has two h1s for about 5.7 s. Per the outcome written in advance, this goes to STORE-1d.
- **Missing footer:** `/store`, the product pages, `/free-downloads`, `/hire-us` and the 404 page have no footer. Those pages now have no footer link to Gift Cards or Hire Us, so the "the footer already links them" ruling only partly holds. This is a STORE-2 decision.
- **Testimonials not shown:** The testimonials and stats component is not used by any page. "Netflix Original Score" and "2,500+ Happy Customers" from Saba's keep-list appear nowhere on the site, and this was already true before this round. B should ask Saba where he saw them before STORE-3 restyles them.
- **Gift card errors:** The console errors on the gift-card section come from the mock, which has no gift-card product.
- **Unknown URLs:** An unknown URL returns HTTP 200 instead of 404. This was already the case.
- **`.text-glow` still in use:** This gradient style is used in about ten other places. B's note that it becomes unused is wrong, so it must not be deleted in a later cleanup.

The first 1280 screenshots picked up a hover glow on Sign In from where my script clicked the popup's Close button. I fixed the script and recaptured 1280, so the saved baseline for the regression round is clean. The full test suite, typecheck, build and verify are left to the gate.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-188.md`
- `c-round-188.json`
- `c-round-188/` (scripts, measurements, screenshots, and the new store-after baseline)
